column1: # Australia (au.cautious): no dominant table. Members: Lakemba Mosque's table (au.lma, the most followed; its 1448 AH
# table at Lakemba) and Diyanet's per-suburb tables (other.turkey, the TURKEY preset to within a minute; Sydney and
# Melbourne, 25 September to 25 October 2026; Diyanet's own district points are not published with the tables, so
# Sydney's is checked at Lakemba, west of the city centre (a later sun), and Melbourne's at its centre). The Brisbane capture (diy-bro) repeats Melbourne's times (its Zuhr falls at Melbourne's
# longitude), a capture fault, and is not used. Maghrib is capped at LMA's where the members spread, so it is not
# checked at Melbourne, where no LMA table is held. No imsak is printed: each Fajr is also the start of the fast.
